The article from *Telecom Review Africa* reports on recent breakthroughs in quantum‑internet technology that could fundamentally reshape global communications. It highlights how advances in quantum networking—such as improved entanglement distribution and secure quantum key exchange—promise faster, more reliable data links and enhanced cybersecurity for international networks. The piece also notes ongoing challenges in scaling the technology and integrating it with existing infrastructure.
